content.text: A solo builder operating under the handle agentshare.dev announced they are developing an API-first data platform focused on real-time Solana DeFi intelligence. The platform provides Meteora DLMM pool briefs, bin depth data, and DEX scouting capabilities. The project is described as fully x402-ready, meaning it is designed to support autonomous agents and micro-billing use cases.

A user named NativeSatoshi announced the launch of Coopa v4.0, a data sovereignty platform built on top of Irys for permanent and immutable data storage. The platform is described as a zero-trust Digital Sanctuary aimed at professional users, offering wallet-based identity, closed-source cryptographic protection, and a feature called Eternal Whispers for sovereign data interaction and messaging. Coopa is normally invite-only but was temporarily opened to the Irys community for stress-testing. Feedback was requested specifically on Irys upload speeds, wallet integration UI, and the overall platform experience. The platform is accessible at coopaassistant.com.
